title: IN THE HEART OF THE HIBERNIAN METROPOLIS
html_source:
Joyce delighted in an array of styles across Ulysses, and for Aeolus employed a style befitting the newspapers of the time, complete with section headings a la the Freeman’s Journal and National Post.

The style continues throughout, with the rhetorical style of a newspaper sometimes comically contrasted with the witty dialogue.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: The ‘Aeolus’ episode is set in the offices of the Freeman’s Journal, located on Prince street, just behind the Hotel Metropole on Sackville street.
